title: screen reader sees web page and tile elements

clauses.text: with the screen reader on, the headings, links, buttons, fields and pictures of a Browser page are read in reading order

steps.do: Turn the screen reader on as in F-A11Y-02, open the Browser tile on a page with headings, links and a picture, then move through the page with Tab.
steps.expect: Each heading, link and picture is read with its name, role and state, in the order of the page.

steps.do: Press Enter on a link the reader has named.
steps.expect: The link is followed; the page changes to the target.

clauses.text: in a WASM tile the Ctrl+B key shows the Screen reader review with the counts of unnamed parts

steps.do: Open a WASM tile, press Ctrl+B, and read the review screen.
steps.expect: The screen says 'Screen reader review' and shows how many clickable parts have no name and the counts, with the verdict on the picture it shows now.
